title: Don't Wake the Brainrots | Moon Hub
features:
[Setup]
[+] Auto Start (delayable)
[+] Friends Only rooms
[+] Start In X Seconds slider
[+] Return to Lobby button

[Story]
[+] Select Story (10 maps)
[+] Select Act (Act1–Act6/Infinite)
[+] Select Difficulty (Normal/Nightmare)
[+] Auto Join Story

[Legend Stages]
[+] Select Legends Stage (Stage2–Stage10)
[+] Select Legends Act (Act1–Act4)
[+] Auto Join Legends Stages (Nightmare)

[Macro]
[+] Record unit placement (hooks UnitEvent)
[+] Play recorded macro
[+] Save macro to file (.json)
[+] List/Select macro files
[+] Play macro from file
[+] In-UI notifications for record/play/save

[Game]
[+] Auto Back to Lobby (on end screen)
[+] Auto Replay (Retry)
[+] Auto Next (Next Act)
[+] Auto Skip Waves
[+] Select Wave (1–50)
[+] Auto Sell (at selected wave)
[+] Auto Leave (at selected wave)
[+] Auto Upgrade Units (periodic)

[Miscellaneous]
[+] Auto Redeem Codes (scrapes latest)
[+] Auto Claim Quests
[+] Auto Claim Battlepass

[Summon]
[+] Auto Summon Units
[+] Select Summon Method (Special/Summer/Selection)
[+] Select Amount (1 or 10)
[+] Select Unit Rarity to sell (multi-select)
[+] Auto Sell Units by rarity

[Webhook]
[+] Set Discord Webhook URL
[+] Test Webhook
[+] End-screen match summary notifications (Act/Difficulty/Stage/Status with image & thumb)

[Player]
[+] Fly (smooth BV/BG; speed slider + mouse wheel adjust)
[+] No Clip
[+] Walk Speed (toggle + slider)
[+] Jump Power (toggle + slider)
[+] Max Camera Zoom (input + slider)

[Config]
[+] Config Name input
[+] List existing configs (dropdown)
[+] Refresh list
[+] Save Config
[+] Load Config
[+] Auto load/save to JSON per user

[Settings]
[+] FPS Cap slider
[+] Join Private Server (Free)
[+] Server Hop
[+] Server Hop (Lowest Server)
[+] Theme selector (Dark/Light/Rose/Plant/Red/Indigo/Sky/Violet/Amber/Emerald/Midnight/Crimson/Monokai Pro/Cotton Candy/Rainbow)
[+] Set Theme
[+] UI Transparency toggle

[Quality of Life / Background]
[+] Auto apply Story/Act/Difficulty selections
[+] Anti-AFK (disables idle connections)
[+] Continuous loops for all automations with error-safe pcall
[+] WindUI window with draggable gradient Open button and version tag (v1.0.0)
